rules.name: Reputation
rules.description: Each time a Saviors model or friendly Follower removes an enemy Survivor as a casualty, or searches a Supply token, roll 1Black. On a Shield, add 1SP to the Saviors' pool.

rules.name: Here's Negan! (Special Order)
rules.description: If one or more enemy Survivors are removed from play as a result of Negan's melee attack roll, Negan may immediately give a +1 Action token to any friendly Saviors within 3", at a cost of 1SP per model.

rules.name: Inventive
rules.description: Laura may discard a Supply counter to add 1White to any Attack roll.

rules.name: Rule Through Fear
rules.description: As a Special Action, Negan may replace one friendly model in his Kill Zone with a Prone Walker. Then, distribute 1Blue +1 Action tokens amongst any friendly Saviors in play (including Negan himself).

rules.name: Bludgeon
rules.description: If an attack roll with this weapon includes any !, any Survivor wounded by this attack is Bitten.
